full_prompt_en: A square, delicately painted rural scene shows a white cottage with a thick thatched roof amid a flowering garden under a pale, hazy sky. The cottage occupies the upper right half of the frame, its long straw colored roof sloping low over uneven whitewashed walls. Two warm red brick chimneys rise above the soft, weathered thatch. Small dark window openings and a narrow doorway punctuate the bright wall, partly concealed by greenery that grows close to the building. A broad tree canopy fills the upper left, painted in layered olive and golden green; its darker trunk and shadowed undergrowth frame a sunlit opening beneath the branches. A pale garden path begins near the lower middle edge, threads through grass and patches of exposed earth, and leads toward the cottage. Near the distant center left, a couple of small figures stand among the planting, their light clothing only lightly described. On the right side of the path, masses of pink, red, blue, and cream blossoms emerge from varied green leaves and taller gray green grasses. Flowers and shrubs on the left are looser and darker, balancing the bright wall and denser right foreground. The paint has a softly washed look, with fine stippled color and short dry strokes building the foliage; outlines are never uniformly hard. Gentle daylight spreads from the open sky across the cottage front and central lawn, while the large tree casts a cooler shade toward the left. The warm straw roof, white walls, and scattered flower colors sit within a calm field of green. The overall composition leads through a luminous garden toward the sheltered cottage, giving the scene a quiet, abundant summer mood.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、刻画细腻的乡村绘画描绘淡雾天空下的繁花园，以及一座厚茅草屋顶的白色小屋。小屋占据画面右上半部，长而稻草色的屋顶低低覆在不平整的白灰墙上。两根暖红色砖烟囱从柔软、风化的草顶上伸出。明亮墙面被几个小小的深色窗洞和一处窄门打断，贴近建筑生长的绿植又遮住了其中一部分。宽大的树冠填满左上方，以层叠的橄榄绿和金绿色描绘；较暗的树干与树下阴影框住枝叶下的受光空隙。一条浅色花园小路从下方中部附近开始，穿过草地与裸露的土斑，通向小屋。偏左的远处中景，几个小人物站在花木之间，浅色衣服只用轻笔带过。小路右侧，粉、红、蓝、奶油色花朵从各色绿叶和更高的灰绿色草丛里浮现。左侧的花与灌木更松散也更暗，平衡亮墙与右前景密集的植物。颜料具有柔和渗洗的外观，细碎点色和短促干笔建立叶丛；轮廓并不处处坚硬。温和日光从开阔天空铺向小屋正面和中央草坪，大树则在左侧投下较冷的阴影。暖稻草色屋顶、白墙与零散花色安放在平静的绿色场域中。整体构图带人穿过明亮花园，走向受庇护的小屋，使画面有宁静而丰盈的夏日气息。
style_prompt_en: A softly washed painting surface combines translucent color with small dry stipples and short textured strokes. Pale cream and warm straw tones form quiet light areas, while many distinct greens move from sunlit yellow olive to cooler deep green. Scattered pink, red, and blue accents interrupt the greens in small irregular clusters rather than broad solid blocks. Forms have legible silhouettes, yet their edges feather and break into surrounding marks, especially where fine texture meets open light. A larger dark mass anchors one side, allowing a brighter central path of values to pull the eye inward. Gentle daylight creates a broad, low contrast glow with localized cool shade instead of hard dramatic shadow. Layered near and far textures give depth without dense line work, and the finest detail is concentrated in the middle ground. The overall effect is tranquil, airy, and richly patterned at close range.
style_prompt_zh: 柔和渗洗的绘画表面将透明色层与细小干点和短促的肌理笔触结合。浅奶油色与暖稻草色形成安静的亮部，诸多不同的绿色从受光的黄橄榄色过渡到较冷的深绿。零散的粉、红、蓝色重音以不规则小簇打断绿调，而非组成宽阔的实色块。形体剪影可辨，但边缘会羽化、破碎成周围的笔迹，尤其是细密纹理与开阔亮处相接之时。一侧较大的暗色块提供支点，让中央更明亮的明度通道将视线引向内部。温和日光形成宽广、低对比的光晕，并带有局部冷阴影，而非生硬的戏剧性投影。远近叠加的肌理无需密集线条也能建立纵深，最细的刻画集中在中景。整体效果宁静、通透，近看又有丰富的纹样节奏。
theme_en: A thatched white cottage amid a flowering garden
theme_zh: 繁花园中有一座白墙茅草顶小屋
name: Arthur Claude Strachan
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
